purpose: Corrections for Marblehead proper nouns that speech recognition reliably mishears in meeting transcripts. Applied by scripts/transcripts/lib/normalize_names.mjs at ingest, and supplied to the Whisper decoder and the summarization prompt so corrections happen at the source where possible.
rules: Every entry needs two kinds of evidence: a `ground_truth` citation to a human-authored file in this repo proving the correct spelling, and an `observed` count of the misheard forms in the corpus (from scripts/transcripts/tools/name_census.mjs).
Matching is case-sensitive and whole-word. List each misheard form exactly as it occurs; do not rely on case folding.
A wrong correction is worse than an uncorrected mishearing, because it reads as authoritative. If the right answer depends on context, put the term in `flag_only` instead.
Never add an entry from memory of how a name is spelled. Cite the file.

Any entry with kind 'person' must carry an `era` field recording the corpus date range the misheard forms appear in, and the tenure that range was checked against. Office-holders change, so a surname correction that is right for one period can corrupt an older meeting. The test suite enforces this field's presence.

replace.ground_truth: README.md; the town name is used throughout the site
replace.observed: 1271 misheard occurrences against 10575 correct ones (~11% error rate on the town's own name). Bare 'Marvel' (451) and bare 'Marble' (287) were sampled across ~25 contexts with zero legitimate uses: 'citizens of Marvel', 'Marble had', 'Marvel head public schools', 'Marble High'.
replace.note: Two-word forms are corrected before the bare forms, so 'Marvel head' does not become 'Marblehead head'.

replace.observed: 'Marble Marblehead' 7, 'Marvel head Marble' 1, 'Marblehead Marble' 1. The ASR splits the town name and then repeats it, so correcting each token separately yields 'Marblehead Marblehead'.
replace.note: Listed separately and matched before the single-token forms, because corrections are single-pass and cannot collapse a doubled result afterward. Deliberately does NOT cover genuine 'Marblehead Marblehead' speaker stutters, of which the corpus has 12 that predate this dictionary and are correct verbatim transcription.
